title: Zoduid - Zodiac Superfluid Enzyme
tagline: A module for Zodiac the Gnosis DAO extension that can be used in conjunction with enzyme vault and superfluid for distribution of funds.
description:
The problem :
A DAO grants the Chiliagon DAO funds to help support and maintain a project. 

How do we distribute the grant in a fair mechanism? Such that - 
1.Developer's get a fair share
2.Profit for DAO without utilizing the capital

We utilize Enzyme to generate yield and when milestones have been met distribute the funds via a Superfluid IDA to the proposed developers.
how_its_made: We created a wrapper around the enzyme Comptroller.sol contract to deposit funds and redeem shares to generate yield. Further we used the simplified sdk from superfluid for now for the IDA creation. We intend to extend the Superfluids smart contract directly in production. So that once a safesnap is created  and reality module confirms all actions can be performed directly from the DAO proposal.
